newsitem.title: UK: Utd News/Chrysalis consortium win ITV F1 contract.
newsitem.headline: Utd News/Chrysalis consortium win ITV F1 contract.

text.p: ITV's Formula One Grand Prix coverage will be provided next year by a consortium comprising Meridian, Anglia and Chrysalis Sport, the UK's ITV commercial television network said on Thursday.
The MACh 1 consortium beat off competition from four rivals bidders to land the contract. Financial details of the deal, which is for an initial two years, were not disclosed.
ITV has a five-year deal to show Formula One from 1997, outbidding the BBC for live rights to the Grand Prix calendar.
Veteran commentator Murray Walker, the BBC's voice of motor racing, is believed likely to switch channels with the sport.
"We challenged the bidders to achieve the highest standards of race coverage and production, together with imaginative features and support programming," said ITV Network Director Marcus Plantin.
"MaCh 1's bid was the most impressive in meeting our objectives," he added.
Regional ITV companies Meridian and Anglia are part of the United News & Media group while Chrysalis Sport is a unit of the Chrysalis entertainment group.
